cost_of_living_text: The average cost of living in Perugia is between €600 and €800 per month. This includes housing, food, transportation, and other expenses.
student_discounts_text: You can get various discounts at museums, cinemas, restaurants, and shops with your student card.
celi_text: The CELI exam is one of the most prestigious Italian language exams, held by the University for Foreigners of Perugia. For more information, visit the university's website.
cils_text: The CILS exam is another prestigious Italian language exam, held by the University of Siena for Foreigners. For more information, visit the university's website.
plida_text: The PLIDA exam is held by the Dante Alighieri Society and is another prestigious Italian language exam. For more information, visit the Dante Alighieri Society website.
